notes.title: SHAFTED Update (v1.0.6)
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[b][BALANCE][/b] Decreased contract amounts in Medium/Stage 2

[b][BUG][/b] Settings VSync correctly applies and saves
[b][BUG][/b] Settings Windowed mode correctly applies
[b][BUG][/b] Fixed black bars on side when using a widescreen resolution

[b][SETTINGS][/b] Removed uncapped framerate option 
[b][SETTINGS][/b] Added FOV slider to options

notes.title: SHAFTED is now available!
notes.content:
SHAFTED is now available to purchase! Enjoy exploring the full version of the game with more stages and buildings. There are tons of strategies to figure out.

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
